title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Cyber Security – Technology Consulting – Infrastructure Security – Zero Trust Security - Senior**
As part of our EY Cyber Security team, you shall be responsible for defining, solutioning, integrating, and implementing innovative solutions which will enhance our service delivery quality, as well as help us strategically elevate technology driven transformation for our clients. You’ll also help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for an Infrastructure Security professional with solution mindset and hands on security engineering expertise in Zero Trust Security, risk and controls concepts, architecture design. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the rollout of next generation market relevant solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* A Security- Design & Architect professional who is responsible for designing, building, testing and implementing security within an organisation’s IT infrastructure- On Prem & Cloud.
* Professional is expected to have a thorough understanding of complex IT systems and stay up to date with the latest security standards, systems and authentication protocols, as well as best practice security products.
* Identify requirements, design document and implement technical solutions for scalable and resilient network architecture.
* Well versed with Zero Trust use cases , business & technical requirements.
* Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
* Experience in Zero-Trust and micro-segmentation solutions including Guardicore and Illumio.
* Individual should possess experience in planning, design, deployment, configuration, integration and management of network protection controls including Next gen firewalls- Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Fortinet, SDN Security, DDoS Protection, IPS, VPN, Wireless security, NAC and network authentication solutions to protect IT assets and should be responsible for deployment of any changes, plug-ins, or configuration as requested by client.
* Proven expertise in designing and delivering SASE transformations across leading platforms such as Palo Alto, Netskope, Zscaler, and Fortinet, including strategy and assessment, vendor selection, PoC validation, architecture design, and enterprise-scale implementation.
* Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate, and manage WAF, proxy/Zscaler solutions.
* Possess hands on experience in segmenting networks, applications, and data to limit exposure to attacks.
* Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate and manage platform protection controls including virtualisation protection solutions on Hypervisors and thin client’s security solutions.
* Good understanding of security concepts and technologies including, but not limited to TCP/IP, LDAP, DHCP, DNS, web filtering etc.
* Should be well-versed with network documentation that includes network drawings, text descriptions and equipment configurations, designing HLDs and LLDs.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Serve as highly technical security expert to bring security transformation to both new and legacy infrastructure.
* Deep technical understanding of architecture and solutioning of infrastructure security components.
* Deep knowledge of services and service delivery approach and methodology for infrastructure security including governance and operating models.
* Proven track record in building and maintaining trusted relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel and flex work timings as and when required.
* Ability to change and adapt in a hyper-growth environment.
* Self-starter and strategic thinker.
* Drive C-suite/senior leadership level meetings and discussion.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and executive presence that enable effective engagement with senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and communicate the technical and security related issues to client/business stakeholders.
* Clearly demonstrates proven extensive abilities with leveraging creative thinking and problem-solving skills, individual initiative, and utilizing Office 365, MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint) and Google Docs.
* Communicating in an organized and knowledgeable manner in written and verbal formats including delivering clear requests for information and communicating potential conflicts.
* Must communicate consistently and drive objectives, relying on fact-based decisions about risk that optimize the trade-off between risk mitigation and business performance.
* Good presentation, project management, facilitation and delivery skills as well as strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to create domain specific training content and deliver training effectively.
* Develop/Implement automation solutions and capabilities that are clearly aligned to client business, technology and threat posture.
* Demonstrates ability to track developments and changes in the digital business and threat environments to ensure that they're adequately addressed in client’s security strategy plans and architecture artefacts.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 6+ years of experience in Information Technology experience, with specialization in Cyber Security roles that include multiple areas of specialization. Professional-level knowledge in areas from the following:

+ Zero Trust Security Strategy and Implementation
+ Security Engineering & Architecture assessments
+ Possess understanding in firewalls, VPNs, NAC, SDWAN, WAF, Proxy, EDR/XDR etc.
+ Expert level experience with deployment, maintenance and operations of one or more major network security Devices
+ Cloud Security Architecture
+ Entrepreneurial approach to solving security problems with consultative skills

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF, Zscaler)

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Job Description: Resilience Manager\- DB**
**Experience Range:** 
 12\-15 years \|
 **Role Level:** 
 Manager
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Lead enterprise database resilience and recovery programs across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role is responsible for assessing database recovery readiness, validating disaster recovery capabilities, strengthening cyber recovery preparedness, and driving database resilience improvements through structured assessments, testing, remediation planning, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead database resilience assessments across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, cloud\-native databases, and related infrastructure dependencies.
* Design, review, and validate database recovery strategies, including recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, recovery tiering, replication, and high availability configurations.
* Plan and execute database DR tests, cyber recovery simulations, failover/failback exercises, and evidence\-based recovery validation activities.
* Assess database backup and recovery architectures for immutability, replication, retention, air\-gap/vaulting controls, RPO/RTO alignment, and restoration readiness.
* Develop cyber recovery playbooks for ransomware and destructive cyber scenarios, including clean\-room recovery, trusted restore points, and database integrity validation.
* Identify resilience gaps, SPOFs, recovery risks, and operational weaknesses, and translate findings into remediation roadmaps and executive reporting.
* Collaborate with cyber security, infrastructure, cloud, application, audit, and business teams to align database recovery capabilities with business priorities.


**Must Have Skills**
* Strong database administration experience across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and cloud database platforms.
* Expertise in database backup, recovery, replication, clustering, high availability, retention management, and restoration processes.
* Familiarity with supporting infrastructure components including storage, virtualization, networking, identity services, and cloud platforms.
* Practical DR knowledge covering failover/failback, workload recovery, recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, validation, and improvement planning.
* Cyber recovery understanding covering ransomware impacts, clean recovery, database integrity validation, identity recovery, Zero Trust principles, and trusted restore capabilities.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, technical documentation, delivery quality, and leadership communication skills.
* Good understanding of on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid hosting models, data center strategies, and database deployment architectures.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, AIOps, observability, and telemetry\-driven solutions supporting runbook generation, dependency analysis, recovery workflow automation, and resilience reporting.
* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms, storage technologies, and infrastructure resilience concepts supporting database recovery.


**Preferred Qualifications And Certifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related discipline.
* Desirable certifications include one or more of the following: Oracle DBA, Microsoft Azure Database Administrator, AWS Database Specialty, Azure Solutions Architect
* Experience in technology transformation, regulated environments, or large\-scale database resilience and recovery programs.


**Preferred Profile Attributes**
* Ability to independently lead workstreams, manage senior stakeholders, and mentor delivery teams.
* Comfortable working across database, infrastructure, cloud, cyber security, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
* Outcome\-focused mindset with emphasis on actionable recommendations, recovery assurance, and measurable resilience improvements.
